annotations.title: Should I pay this x402 seller? (paid)

description: Use before an agent pays an x402 endpoint it has not used before: reads the seller's own 402 challenge, screens every payTo wallet against the OFAC list, checks the domain (age, setup), Factline's daily uptime probes and, with company, the register record and EU/UN/UK/US sanctions. Returns allow, review or deny, plus a trust-provider block (decision, score, evidence, ttl). Input: url, optional wallet, company, country. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.
